entries.summary: 1353, die 16 maji, Ecclesiae herbipolensis capitulum de receptione trium canonicorum et quibusdam aliis statuit
entries.latin:
Jn nomine domini amen.
Nos Heinricus de Reinstein decanus, Johannes Pin-
cerna de Erpach archidiaconus, Johannes de Rosenberg,
Engelhardus de Bebenburg, Ernestus de Ristenhusen, et
Fridericus de Kastel, arbitri seu conpromissarij super articulis in
littera conpromissi expressatis eorumque dependencijs emergentibus et
connexis a .. capitulo (nemine discrepante) concorditer deputati, affec-
tantesque desidijs dubijs interpretando declarando ac diffiniendo oc-
currere in premissis quantum possumus infuturum, auctoritate igitur
nobis in hac parte conmissa prouide duximus ordinandum ac pre-
sentibus ordinamus, quod quando recepcio trium dominorum infra-
scriptorum dumtaxat, videlicet domini de Eberstein, de Hanawe,
et nominandi seu presentandi per dominum .. episcopum nunc, qui
hactenus nominacionem ac presentacionem supradictas tamquam .. pre-
positus noster tunc fuerat assecutus, inminet facienda, quod tunc
dominus .. decanus ceterique domini nostri capitulares in Karlstat
residentes prefatos dominos ad prebendas et canonicatus vacantes
tamquam capitulum ecclesie nostre representantes recipere debeant,
contradictione cuiuslibet non obstante.
Si vero dominus .. decanus residenciam in loco prefato non ha-
buerit, extunc .. senior inter residentes aut alius ex eis requisitus,
cum senior hoc non potuerit uel noluerit adinplere, dominum .. de-
canum, dum tamen in dyocesi existat, in certum terminum iuxta
loci distanciam a residentibus uel maiori parte ex eisdem prefigen-
dum, dolo et fraude penitus circumscriptis, ad prefatam canonici
recepcionem faciendam conuocare teneatur. Alioquin, si non ve-
nerit, vel vices suas alij non conmiserit, residentes hoc faciant,
prout hoc de consuetudine est hactenus introductum.
Jdem in oblagijs hereditarijs et curijs transferendis, et publi-
cacionibus testamentorum nostrorum statuimus obseruandum.
Jnsuper duximus statuendum, quod quociens nostri concanonici
se ad capitulum et ad actus capitulares admitti insistunt vigore
forme super assignacione prebendarum ac recepcione seu admissione
ad capitulum sub annis domini M° CCC° VIII feria sexta ante festum
beati Georij martiris per capitulum consensu et auctorizacione quon-
dam reuerendi in Cristo patris ac domini domini Ottonis episcopi
herbipolensis accedentibus promulgate, extunc dominus .. de-
canus, si presens fuerit, alioquin senior inter residentes, uel alius
ex eis ut predicitur, dum tamen dominus .. decanus predictus requisitus
fuerit vt est dictum, residentes in loco sub debito juramenti con-
uocare teneatur. Et quicquid domini nostri supradicti in huiusmodj
recepcione capitulari decreuerint, iuxta formam tamen et mentem
forme supradicte interpretacionis discussionis ac suplecionis eiusdem
ac litteras sigillo capituli sigillatas, hoc tamquam ab vnanimi capi-
tulo nostre ecclesie factum roboris firmitatem optinere debebit.
Ad obseruanciam igitur inconuulsam ac euidens testimonium
premissorum capituli nostri sigillum ac conpromissariorum sigilla
predictorum ex certa nostra sciencia presentibus sunt appensa.
Datum anno domini M° CCC° Lmo tercio, XVI kalendas junij.
entries.english:
In the name of the Lord, amen. We, Heinrich von Reinstein, dean, Johannes Schenk von Erbach, archdeacon, Hans von Rosenberg, Engelhard von Bebenburg, Ernst von Ristenhusen and Friedrich von Kastel, arbitrators or compromissaries concordantly deputed by the chapter (none dissenting) on the articles expressed in the letter of compromise and their dependencies, arising and connected, desiring by interpreting, declaring and defining doubtful points to meet as far as we can in the future the matters in the foregoing, have, by the authority committed to us in this matter, prudently resolved to ordain and by these presents ordain: when the reception of three lords named below only, namely the lord of Eberstein, the lord of Hanau, and one to be named or presented by the lord bishop now, who until now obtained the aforesaid nomination and presentation as our provost at the time, is imminent, the lord dean and the other capitular lords of ours resident in Karlstadt, representing the chapter of our church, shall receive the aforesaid lords to vacant prebends and canonries, any objection notwithstanding.
But if the lord dean has no residence in the said place, then the senior among the residents or another of them, when requested, since the senior could not or would not do it, shall be bound to summon the lord dean, provided he is in the diocese, by a fixed term to be set by the residents or the majority of them according to the distance of the place, all guile and fraud excluded, to make the said reception of the canon. Otherwise, if he does not come or has not committed his place to another, the residents shall do it, as has hitherto been introduced by custom.
We decree that the same be observed in transferring hereditary offerings and courts, and in publications of our testaments.
Moreover we have decided to establish that whenever our fellow canons insist on being admitted to the chapter and to capitular acts by virtue of the form concerning the assignment of prebends and reception or admission to the chapter, promulgated in the year of the Lord 1308 on the Friday before the feast of the blessed martyr George by the chapter, with the consent and authorization of the late reverend father in Christ and lord Lord Otto, bishop of Würzburg, then the lord dean, if present, otherwise the senior among the residents or another of them as stated, provided the lord dean aforesaid has been requested as said, shall be bound under the duty of oath to summon the residents in the place. And whatever our aforesaid lords decide in such a capitular reception, in accordance with the form and meaning of the form of the aforesaid interpretation, discussion and supplement of it and the letters sealed with the chapter's seal, this shall obtain firmness of strength as done by the unanimous chapter of our church.
For the unshaken observance and evident testimony of the foregoing, our chapter's seal and the seals of the aforesaid compromissaries are appended to these presents with our certain knowledge.
Given in the year of the Lord 1353, on the sixteenth day before the Kalends of June.
